[spoiler=Important virus news flash][b]The Daily Nordiheim News Flash[/b]
The modern and clean looking news room of 'Nordiheim News' comes up on the screen with  the male reporter Jarli siting behind the desk, still alone since the emergency restrictions are still in place.
Whit a bit more gusto then normal he welcomes the audience and starts the news.
[i]Welcome to the daily news flash of today for your quick but "important" update on news in the nation of Nordiheim.[/i]
He quick places the papers he has on his desk  in front of himself.
[i]Today we will start with the news regarding the Lyondar Virus as there have been several new updates regarding it with one in peticular being important.[/i]

A picture of the symbol used by the Nordiheim department of healt comes up on the screen behind Jarli, the Nordiheimian four pointed star in green with a white Rod of Asclepius inn its center.
[i]The Department of health report that while originaly a majority of medical and biological scientists belived the Lyondar virus to be a form of heavly mutated SARS virus the [u]antibodies test[/u] proved that this was compleatly wrong, as it showed almoust immidiatly that they did noting to any virus strain from the SARS family.
Instead they had a large and effective ability to take out influenza viruses wich they did with gusto apparently, these viruses are of the virus family Orthomyxoviridae, several of the scientists that was wrong have admited to fealing rather embarrassed about their mistake but are glad that this could be corrected so quickly.[/i]

The background screen switches to show the face of a middelaged man with light dark brown skin and short short grey-sih hair and beard that is wearing glasses that has the destinct look of a scientist or doctor.
[i]Scientist Dr. Mangana Bambamson who is the unoficial leader of the minority group of scientists and doctors that did not tink the first asumption of the Virus being a SARS virus could be concluded with certainty, and one of the loudest voices behind the demanded that the 'antibodies test' had to be done as fast as posible after they were able to extract the recovered patients antibodies, says that he is glad that the majorety group listened and agreed to do the test as finding and gaining all posible information about a subject is how a "true scientist" does their research and that this discovery might have prevented the loss of resources and time that could have happened if this test had not been done.
He also said, and I quote, "I am releaved that my colleagues pride did not blind them to the scientific need of doing the antibodies test, not joust from what we have learned but also as a matter of scientific principle".[/i]

Jarli moves a section of the papers he has infront of him on the desk to the side before continuing.
[i]Also on the matter of the virus, the first antibodies injections have been distributed to hospitals in Aboria and Ostland to be used on the virus victims that are in more severe stages of the Lyondar virus, wich mainly contains people of Aboriginal and Olian direct decent, this should hopefull increase their chances of fighting off the virus and survive this horrible ordeal.
There is also news from the laboratories in Sorland that the growing of LV2B is proceeding with great results meaning that the next biggest hurdle for making a vaccine is turning it into a dead state that the body will react to and create antibodies for without adverse effects, and since they now know that it is from the influenza family they can now narrow down how to proceed with this.
The Nordiheim department of health have also said that it is looking for volunteers to test the vaccine for side effects and effectiveness, saying that anyone that would suffer adverse effects from this will be propperly compensated according to Nordiheim law.[/i]

The screen behind Jarli schanges to that of a stock graph.
[i]With those important news out of the way it's time for the news about the matter of money.[/i] He says with a slighty humorous smille.

He proseeds to talk about several ecconomic matters such as the increase in exports, new trade deals and the relativly bright outlooks for the ecconomy despite the severe lockdown rules/laws, as it seems there is a possibility for a increase in wages when the lockdown eventualy will be lifted and production and consumption can [i]"get back to buisiness"[/i]
There is also a mention about the continuing upgrades to the dry docks in Nordland and Ostland, untill the News flash is over and he signs out.
But for the most part only the ecconomicaly inclined/interested watch this part.[/spoiler]
